essence: Twenty-nine approximations that cancel themselves: no helper, no hinderer (1); sourced yet self-born (2); how could things reach His path (3); the sated wander (4); timeless vision (5); entering by resolve (6); pure play (7); fearless dwelling (8); dissolved, drunk, wandering (9); pretense suffices (10); one-taste drinking (11); the essence-extract (12); inside/outside puzzle (13); facing everywhere in agitation (14); reveal the abode (15); fled yet never unseen (16); flood to joy (17); grain for worship-exchange (18); seeing each thing, seeing You (19); unhaunting mind questioned (20); ploughmen see (21); feast unstopped (22); insight, power, unpausing worship (23); sense-heap as His limb (24); roaming mind, skilled service (25); slave by His will, yet faceless (26); opponents wondered at (27); things as things by His being (28); nothing/something grammar of worship (29).

sections.SUMMARY: Twenty-nine approximations that cancel themselves: no helper, no hinderer (1); sourced yet self-born (2); how could things reach His path (3); the sated wander (4); timeless vision (5); entering by resolve (6); pure play (7); fearless dwelling (8); dissolved, drunk, wandering (9); pretense suffices (10); one-taste drinking (11); the essence-extract (12); inside/outside puzzle (13); facing everywhere in agitation (14); reveal the abode (15); fled yet never unseen (16); flood to joy (17); grain for worship-exchange (18); seeing each thing, seeing You (19); unhaunting mind questioned (20); ploughmen see (21); feast unstopped (22); insight, power, unpausing worship (23); sense-heap as His limb (24); roaming mind, skilled service (25); slave by His will, yet faceless (26); opponents wondered at (27); things as things by His being (28); nothing/something grammar of worship (29).
sections.FUNCTION: Approximation-song: the longest so far, because pointing takes more words than stating — each verse a finger, none the moon.
sections.KEY TERMS:
* **rahasyanirdeśa** — pointing to the secret: indication, not exposition; it's whole method.
* **sārasaṃgraha** — essence-extract (v.12): the one portable rule; memorize this verse and the rest are commentary.
* **pratyartharūpa** — the counter-form (v.27): even opposition gets wondered at, not warned against.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Twelfth song: the hinge before Utpala's own three (13–15). Read slowly; it teaches how to read everything after it — approximately, then all at once.
sections.EXPLANATION: It alternates accusation (1, 15, 16, 26, 27) with instruction (6, 8, 11, 12, 24), wonder (3, 17, 27) with domestication (4, 7, 9, 21, 22), metaphysics (5, 13, 28, 29) with devotion (10, 14, 18, 23, 25). No verse stands alone; each corrects the last — too abandoned (12), then the puzzle returns (13); too certain (17), then exchange (18); too served (25), then faceless (26). The ending (28–29) turns ontology into benediction and grammar into worship: being itself becomes the blessing form, and the nothing/something pattern becomes the final rite.
sections.BOUNDARY: Verses 10 (pretense), 18 (exchange), and 27 (opponents) are deliberately left at wonder pitch; resolving them would unmake it's method. The (?) in GRETIL 12.3 is the edition's, kept visible. Verse 20's unhaunting mind is questioned, not answered.
sections.RELATED:
* Stotra 13 (saṃgraha): the summary its approximations feed.
* Stotra 10, v.13 (mere conduct): the same minimum-means logic, softer.
* Stotra 1, v.7 (self-established devotion): the ground beneath v.12's extract.
